media.caption: Bedding material staged on the barge, paid for with carbon credits — washed over the side exactly where the chart says.

media.caption: Rock recovered from the lease after bedding: new oyster spat already cemented on and building shell.

media.alt: A pile of river rock on deck, nearly every piece carrying young oyster spat
media.caption: Not one lucky rock — a deck sample of the placed river rock, spat on nearly every piece. This is the reef the December resurvey confirmed.

media.alt: Survey dredge basket full of oysters being hauled aboard at the boat's rail
media.caption: A density sample comes aboard. Every tow is counted by hand and logged to the field maps on the spot.

media.alt: Map of thousands of colored polling points outlining reef across two oyster leases
media.caption: Thousands of soundings, plotted — dense enough that the reef outlines itself.
